meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把分镜、配音和字幕合成为可发布的视频成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常做视频合成剪辑,需要批量渲染并发布到不同平台。
copy.tagline_en: Turn storyboards, voiceover and subtitles into publishable video renders.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you produce video content and need to render and publish it in batches.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 命令帮你搭视频项目、写合成、跑检查与预览,并渲染出 mp4 文件,也能排查构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当你要求做 HyperFrames 视频项目(初始化、写合成、渲染),或排查构建、渲染失败时触发;支持本地与云端渲染。

say.text: 帮我初始化一个 HyperFrames 项目,再打开 Studio 预览
say.note: 先搭空项目,再给出预览链接

say.text: 先用 catalog 搜“逐行显示标题”的动画,装进项目
跑一次 check,通过后用 delivery 画质渲染 out.mp4
say.note: check 含 lint,渲染前需你批准

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives the HyperFrames CLI (npx hyperframes) to scaffold a video project, author compositions, run lint/check and preview, and render approved output to mp4; it can also diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for a HyperFrames video project (init, authoring, render), or when diagnosing build or render failures; covers local and cloud rendering.

say_en.text: Init a HyperFrames project for me, then open the Studio preview
say_en.note: Scaffolds a blank project, then gives a preview URL

say_en.text: Search the catalog for a one-line-at-a-time headline reveal and add it
Run check, then if it passes render out.mp4 at delivery quality
say_en.note: check includes lint; render needs your approval
